mapper.select: select id,a.zid,nsrsbh,nsrmc,b.sname from jcfx_nsr_sample_sub a ,jcfx_nsr_sample b where a.zid = b.zid and b.zid = #{pkid} and b.swjgDm=#{swjgDm}

select t.djxh,t.nsrsbh,t.shxydm,t.nsrmc,t.qyhgdm from jcfx_nsr_badj t where t.swjgdm like #{swjgDm}||'%'
and t.nsrsbh like '%'||#{param.nsrsbh}||'%'
and t.qyhgdm like '%'||#{param.qyhgdm}||'%'
and t.nsrmc like '%'||#{param.nsrmc}||'%'
and not exists (select 1 from jcfx_nsr_sample_sub s where s.djxh=t.djxh and s.zid=#{param.zid})

SELECT A.SWJGDM, BA_HS as baHs, SB_HS as sbHs, SB_TSE as sbTse, SB_MDE as sbMde, HZ_HS as hzHs, HZ_TSE as hzTse, HZ_MDE as hzMde, BL_HS as blHs, BL_TSE as blTse, BL_MDE as blMde, BA_HS_L as baHsL, SB_HS_L as sbHsL, SB_TSE_L as sbTseL, SB_MDE_L as sbMdeL, HZ_HS_L as hzHsL, HZ_TSE_L as hzTseL, HZ_MDE_L as hzMdeL, BL_HS_L as blHsL, BL_TSE_L as blTseL, BL_MDE_L as blMdeL FROM (SELECT T.SWJGDM,COUNT(1) AS BA_HS FROM JCFX_NSR_BADJ T WHERE T.SWJGDM LIKE #{preSwjgdm}||'%' and T.SWJGDM LIKE #{swjgdm}||'%' AND TO_CHAR(NVL(T.BACHSJ,SYSDATE),'YYYYMM')>=#{ssnyStart} AND TO_CHAR(T.SQ_DATE,'YYYYMM')<=#{ssnyEnd} GROUP BY T.SWJGDM) A INNER JOIN (SELECT T.SWJGDM, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN S.CK_SB_TSE+S.CK_SB_MDE<>0 THEN S.DJXH ELSE NULL END) AS SB_HS, SUM(S.CK_SB_TSE) AS SB_TSE, SUM(S.CK_SB_MDE) AS SB_MDE, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN S.CK_HZ_TSE+S.CK_HZ_MDE<>0 THEN S.DJXH ELSE NULL END) AS HZ_HS, SUM(S.CK_HZ_TSE) AS HZ_TSE, SUM(S.CK_HZ_MDE) AS HZ_MDE, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN S.CK_BL_TSE+S.CK_BL_MDE<>0 THEN S.DJXH ELSE NULL END) AS BL_HS, SUM(S.CK_BL_TSE) AS BL_TSE, SUM(S.CK_BL_MDE) AS BL_MDE FROM JCFX_NSR_BADJ T INNER JOIN JCFX_DATA_QYYHZ S ON S.DJXH=T.DJXH WHERE T.SWJGDM LIKE #{preSwjgdm}||'%' and T.SWJGDM LIKE #{swjgdm}||'%' AND S.NY>=#{ssnyStart} AND S.NY<=#{ssnyEnd} GROUP BY T.SWJGDM) B ON B.SWJGDM=A.SWJGDM LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.SWJGDM,COUNT(1) AS BA_HS_L FROM JCFX_NSR_BADJ T WHERE T.SWJGDM LIKE #{preSwjgdm}||'%' and T.SWJGDM LIKE #{swjgdm}||'%' AND TO_CHAR(NVL(T.BACHSJ,SYSDATE),'YYYYMM')>=#{lastYearSsnyStart} AND TO_CHAR(T.SQ_DATE,'YYYYMM')<=#{lastYearSsnyEnd} GROUP BY T.SWJGDM) C ON C.SWJGDM=A.SWJGDM LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.SWJGDM, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN S.CK_SB_TSE+S.CK_SB_MDE<>0 THEN S.DJXH ELSE NULL END) AS SB_HS_L, SUM(S.CK_SB_TSE) AS SB_TSE_L, SUM(S.CK_SB_MDE) AS SB_MDE_L, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN S.CK_HZ_TSE+S.CK_HZ_MDE<>0 THEN S.DJXH ELSE NULL END) AS HZ_HS_L, SUM(S.CK_HZ_TSE) AS HZ_TSE_L, SUM(S.CK_HZ_MDE) AS HZ_MDE_L, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN S.CK_BL_TSE+S.CK_BL_MDE<>0 THEN S.DJXH ELSE NULL END) AS BL_HS_L, SUM(S.CK_BL_TSE) AS BL_TSE_L, SUM(S.CK_BL_MDE) AS BL_MDE_L FROM JCFX_NSR_BADJ T INNER JOIN JCFX_DATA_QYYHZ S ON S.DJXH=T.DJXH WHERE T.SWJGDM LIKE #{preSwjgdm}||'%' and T.SWJGDM LIKE #{swjgdm}||'%' AND S.NY>=#{lastYearSsnyStart} AND S.NY<=#{lastYearSsnyEnd} GROUP BY T.SWJGDM) D ON D.SWJGDM=A.SWJGDM

select tsswjg_dm as swjg ,tsywlx,sum(mylaj) as mylaj ,sum(rmblaj) as rmblaj,sum(sb_tmse) as sbTmse,sum(hz_tmse) as Hztmse from ( select tsswjg_dm,tsywlx,mylaj,rmblaj,tmse as sb_tmse,0 as hz_tmse from JCFX_DATA_TSSBMX_TSYW t where t.tsswjg_dm like #{preSwjgdm}||'%'
and tsywlx in (${tsywlxSql})
and (sbny between #{ssnyStart} and #{ssnyEnd}) union all select tsswjg_dm,tsywlx,0 as mylaj, 0 as rmblaj,0 as sb_tmse,tmse as hz_tmse from JCFX_DATA_TSSBMX_TSYW t where t.tsswjg_dm like #{preSwjgdm}||'%'
and tsywlx in (${tsywlxSql})
and (hzny between #{ssnyStart} and #{ssnyEnd}) ) group by tsswjg_dm,tsywlx

select a.field ,b.TABLE_NAME as tableName,b.COLUMN_NAME as columnName from jcfx_cs_zbxm a, user_tab_columns b where b.Table_Name=UPPER(a.dicttable) and (b.COLUMN_NAME like '%_DM' or b.COLUMN_NAME like '%_MC') group by b.TABLE_NAME,b.COLUMN_NAME,a.field
